tools.description:
Search live hotel and accommodation listings near specific coordinates — a landmark, address, venue, or neighborhood — aggregated via trivago's metasearch of major booking sites. Returns the same, filterable results as trivago-accommodation-search. Use when the user anchors their search to a place rather than a named destination (e.g. "near the stadium," "within walking distance of X").

tools.description:
Forecast monthly hotel price trends for a destination — average, minimum, and maximum nightly rate by star rating, across a date window. Use for planning questions like "when is the cheapest month to visit X" or "how do prices change through the year" — this is a forecasting tool, not a live-availability search.

Additional Information: {"knownInformation":{"currentYear":"2026","today":"2026-10-17"}}

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code that determines market-specific pricing and content. Default: US.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used to display prices. Default: USD.

end_month.description: Optional end year-month in YYYY-MM format (e.g. 2026-12). Must not be before start_month. Requires start_month to also be set.

hotel_rating.description:
The hotel star ratings to include in the price statistics.
		Only 3, 4, and 5-star hotels are supported — forecasted price statistics are not available for 1 or 2-star hotels.
		Set true or false for each rating. Multiple ratings can be selected.
		When no rating is selected, the results default to 3-star hotels only.

3star.description: Include 3-star hotels in the price statistics

4star.description: Include 4-star hotels in the price statistics

5star.description: Include 5-star hotels in the price statistics

language.description: Language code for translated content (e.g. EN_US, DE_DE, ZH_HANS_CN). Default: EN_US.

query.description:
Destination query. Accepts two formats:
- Free-text destination name, e.g. "Berlin", "Paris", "New York".
- Coordinate pair in the format lat:<latitude>,long:<longitude>, e.g. "lat:52.52,long:13.405". The nearest destination to those coordinates is used. Latitude must be in [-90, 90] and longitude in [-180, 180].

start_month.description: Optional start year-month in YYYY-MM format (e.g. 2026-06). When omitted, the bridge defaults to the current month plus the next two months. It must be set when end_month is set.

tools.name: trivago-destination-price-trends

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used to format prices in the response.

destinations.description: Destinations matching the query, each with a list of monthly price statistics.

monthly_prices.description: Monthly price statistics for this destination, ordered by month.

month.description: Year and month in YYYY-MM format.

star_rating_prices.description: Per-star-rating price statistics for this month.

average_price.description: Average forecasted nightly price for the month, formatted in the requested currency.

maximum_price.description: Maximum forecasted nightly price for the month, formatted in the requested currency.

minimum_price.description: Minimum forecasted nightly price for the month, formatted in the requested currency.
